title: Name a procedure
prompt: This procedure gives back a greeting. Fill in the word that starts a procedure definition.
explanation: def names the procedure and its input. Here the input is called name.

title: Give back a result
prompt: The input is a number. Give back the number that is one larger.
explanation: return gives back result and finishes this use of the procedure.

title: Test a condition
prompt: If it is raining, recommend a coat. Otherwise, recommend a jumper. is_raining() checks the weather for us.
explanation: if tests the condition; else gives the alternative when it is false.

title: Read a list
prompt: Say hello to every name in a list. greet(name) says hello to that person.
code:
def greet_everyone(names):
    ___ name ___ names:
        greet(name)
    return "finished"
explanation: for name in names repeats the indented instruction once for each name.

title: Stop at a match
prompt: Find out whether Ada is on a list. == tests whether two names are the same. Give back yes at the first match, or no after checking the whole list.
explanation: return ends the procedure as soon as Ada is found. The final return is outside the loop, so it is reached only if no name matched.
